module.glitch.desc: Fixes ticks and skips from audio-interface buffer dropouts, where a few samples were lost and the waveform jumps. Turn it on if you hear tiny clicks in otherwise clean audio.
module.declip.desc: Rebuilds peaks that were flattened because the input gain was too high. Turn it on if loud words sound crushed or distorted.
module.denoise.desc: Removes background noise and room sound from speech with the MossFormer2 model. Needs an NVIDIA GPU.
module.speech.desc: Finds the parts louder than the room's noise floor (open and close thresholds), then decides which are voice: speech, laughs and character voices stay; knocks, room noise, hum and music go silent. The Silero VAD model (downloaded on first use) only helps classify. Exports two tracks, the speech and what was cut, which add up to the original.
module.speech.hint: Silences everything that is not talking
module.speech.settingsHint: Pauses shorter than the before + after margins plus the pause setting are never cut. A hand edit of a storytelling episode used about 50 / 100 / 300 ms; 500 ms margins keep every pause under a second.
